columns.name: status_updates
columns.description: Eligible status updates, once per vitals counter multiple of 60 while the actor is active and alive. Shared timer groups are engine contracts, not independent per-rule durations. Paralysis and numbness use separate actor timers with the same authored duration. Poison and regeneration reset the same HP pulse timer; AI uses these same intervals. Zero duration disables expiry; HP pulse intervals must be positive. Actor/save capacity 255.
